name: Fino Premium Touch Hair Mask 230gm | Japan
description:
Fino Premium Touch Hair Mask 230gm | Japan 
This Item is Made in both JAPAN and TAIWAN 
This Hair Mask is formulated with Royal Jelly Ex to moisturize, Pca (PCA refers to sodium pyrrolidone carboxylate (sodium PCA)), to strengthen, and lipidure ex to repair, leaving your hair nourished 
Shiny hair 
How to use: After rinsing shampoo, massage into hair and rinse. Use 1-2 times a week 
Helps to penetrate moisture to hair, control the water(moist) in the hair, tightening, repair the inner and outer layer, shine effect, and lengthen the coloring effectively.
